'''Jaril''' is an orphan boy, age 6, from [[Sienda]] in [[Amadicia]].

==Activities==

After his parents die during the riots that broke out in Sienda, Jaril and his brother [[Seve]] are cared for by [[Marigan]], Moghedien in disguise. The [[Forsaken]] uses the boys to help disguise herself as a refugee and ask for [[Nynaeve al'Meara|Nynaeve&nbsp;al'Meara]] and [[Elayne Trakand]]'s help, who take them to Salidar. Once Moghedien is discovered she states that she did not contribute to the children's state, who did not speak because they were in shock. Eventually the boys recover and are seen running and playing in Salidar.
